headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic Designer with hands-on experience executing 100+ digital and print marketing assets, brand collaterals, and social campaigns.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Adobe Firefly

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production, social/marketing creative, design systems

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready file production including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Applied AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Created logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Designed social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.
Developed wireframes and prototypes for digital products.
Partnered with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: AT Creation Branding Kit
bullets: Developed comprehensive branding kit including logo, typography, and palette.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her recent graphic design role at Ascent Business Solutions, emphasizing print production, asset creation volume, and brand collateral execution to match the Patni Toyota graphic design role.
omitted: Bounceless UX case study - stretch, as this is a graphic design role focused on brand and marketing collaterals rather than B2B UX product design.
Framer and Webflow working skills - stretch, not requested by the primary graphic design focus of this posting.
